headline: Sandbank collapse kills 5 incl. children in Deir el-Balah as storm floods 70,000 Gaza tents
dek: Heavy rain since late Friday Nov 6 caused a sandbank/earthen embankment to collapse onto tents sheltering displaced families at a shelter centre south of Deir el-Balah, central Gaza, on Sunday Nov 8. At least 5 people killed; victims named as Sala Nabhan, Mariam Nabhan, Reem, Ibrahim and Habiba al…
sources: Gaza Civil Defence (spokesman Mahmud Bassal) + local health authorities, via Al Jazeera; TRT World; Times of Israel liveblog
fault_line: Who left 70,000 tents to flood -- the weather, or the shelter aid that never got in? The fault line is whether the deaths are a natural disaster or a blockade consequence.

sections.what_happened: Heavy rain since late Friday Nov 6 caused a sandbank/earthen embankment to collapse onto tents sheltering displaced families at a shelter centre south of Deir el-Balah, central Gaza, on Sunday Nov 8. At least 5 people killed; victims named as Sala Nabhan, Mariam Nabhan, Reem, Ibrahim and Habiba al Zein (two families). Gaza Civil Defence pulled several injured from the tents and continues searching for survivors; 6 injured reported. Storm flooded 70,000 tents (Government Media Office), damaged shelters of ~350,000 displaced people, caused ~$3m damage; Civil Defence received 1,500+ emergency calls and could respond to only a fraction. ~400,000 displaced Palestinians shelter in locations 'highly vulnerable' to more flooding (AJ); ~950,000 displaced in flood-prone areas (Higher Presidential Committee for Church Affairs, Nov 7 appeal). Hamas rejected the Israeli military's claim it is coordinating a flood response for displaced Palestinians (AJ liveblog).
sections.what_verified: Al Jazeera (T2) + TRT World (T3) + Times of Israel (T3) + Anadolu via EconoTimes (T3) all confirm the collapse, the 5 deaths and the Deir el-Balah location; AJ and TRT both carry Bassal/Civil Defence as the source. Gaza floods storm context already recorded in totw-20261108-0300-03 (2,166 distress calls) but the 5 deaths from the sandbank collapse were never recorded.
sections.what_disputed: CHILD-COUNT DISCREPANCY (flag for production -- do not state one breakdown as settled): AJ/local health authorities say FOUR children among the 5 dead; TRT/Civil Defence spokesman Bassal say THREE children and TWO women; Democrata/Filastin say three children, one woman, six injured. Victims named (Sala Nabhan, Mariam Nabhan, Reem, Ibrahim, Habiba al Zein) do not resolve ages. SHELTER-AID FAULT LINE: TRT's related framing is 'Israel strikes Gaza and blocks shelter aid as floods hit displacement camps'; Hamas rejects Israel's coordination claim; no independent verification in-window of who is blocking what. The 5 deaths are weather/collapse deaths, not strike deaths -- do not narrate them as a strike toll.
sections.why_matters: The rain killed them, not a bomb: five displaced Palestinians, mostly children, buried when a sandbank collapsed onto their tents while 70,000 tents flooded across Gaza. Winter is now the killer in Gaza.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP -- Sandbank collapse kills 5 incl. children in Deir el-Balah as storm floods 70,000 Gaza tents; 1,500+ emergency calls

totw_analysis: Our read: The rain killed them, not a bomb: five displaced Palestinians, mostly children, buried when a sandbank collapsed onto their tents while 70,000 tents flooded across Gaza. Winter is now the killer in Gaza. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Who left 70,000 tents to flood -- the weather, or the shelter aid that never got in? The fault line is whether the deaths are a natural disaster or a blockade consequence.
